environment: macOS Otis, private self-hosted Convex, Bun 1.4.0, e2e 0.15.1 / Chromium

convexReview.auth: Owner identity enforced on reads and feedback writes; machine and anonymous writes denied.
convexReview.data: Separate feedback table, immutable idempotent requests, bounded indexed reads and no manufactured technical grades.
convexReview.capture: Current enrollment/content policy rechecked before reading excerpts; current capture revisions stay distinct from preserved evaluation snapshots.
convexReview.schema: Additive table and defaulted view fields preserve stored evaluations and old clients.

firstFailures.observed: Multiple paginate calls in one query were rejected by Convex.
firstFailures.resolution: Indexed iteration with per-turn and overall byte/count limits; native backend tests pass.

firstFailures.observed: Repeated check text and draft/history text made browser locators ambiguous.
firstFailures.resolution: Scoped selection of the expected rendered observation/history; final component cases pass.

firstFailures.observed: A trace assertion ran during loading, and a reused local fixture no longer had exactly one feedback record.
firstFailures.resolution: Wait for expanded trace content and find history without assuming an empty record; fresh saved comment survives reload.

firstFailures.observed: The screenshot scroll helper returned undefined, outside the browser evaluate JSON type.
firstFailures.resolution: Return null explicitly; local strict types pass. Runtime product files unchanged.

notes: Local persisted browser proof exercised the unchanged feedback path before final presentation polish; final component and live journeys cover the delivered page.
